messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT PAGER — hosted-api: region-us-east GPU pool exhaustion (P1) :rotating_light:
opsbot: Symptoms: request queue growth, p95/p99 token latency spike, downstream request timeouts. Auto-scaler reported failures provisioning new instances.
opsbot: Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/incidents/2965432100

sarah: acknowledging, taking primary. seeing queue backlog on the dashboard: queue length ~ 3.9k, p95 token latency 1.2s -> 4.8s, p99 -> 12.7s.
ben: oncall here, joining. any hit to customer-facing errors?
support-bot: Alerts: 27k 5xxs in last 10m, top affected product: embeddings-api, customer segments: prod-high (ID: ch_823).
mike: grabbing autoscaler logs now, running: `kubectl -n hosted get events --selector=app=autoscaler --since=15m`
mike: logs show repeated quota errors from cloud provider: `QuotaExceeded: Cannot allocate GPU instances in us-east1-b` at 2965432056
anya: that matches the thin-provision pool failure I flagged earlier. Pool hit max-instance limit and eviction loop started.
lia: can we fallback to smaller-model variant (gpt-small-quant) for non-critical requests?
sarah: yes, plan: 1) enable region fallback routing to other regions 2) enable model-degrade policy for embeddings->smaller model for background jobs 3) throttle heavy customers and enable burst queue drain.
ben: heavy customers = prod-high group, do we have an automated per-customer circuit-breaker we can flip?
infra-sre: we do. Endpoint `/v1/admin/circuit-breakers` — can toggle. I can flip to 50% for prod-high.
anya: meanwhile, can someone open cloud quota support ticket? provisioning blocked by quota. I tried from console and hit soft limit.
mike: opening support ticket now: case 12345678 opened with Provider-Cloud. ETA 2-4 hours typical.
sarah: immediate mitigations first. Ben, flip circuit breaker and add HTTP 429 with Retry-After for heavy customers. Lia, start rollout of model-degrade routing (traffic-split 70/30 to gpt-small-quant).
ben: done — circuit-breaker toggled for prod-high to 50%. logs: `{
